name: sitescout-scoring
description: Ranks candidate store locations (H3 cells) for a category and tier. Reads pre-computed area features from the SiteScout PostGIS database (read-only), applies the category's scoring weights, the user's questionnaire answers and hard constraints, and returns the top zones with a score breakdown, drivers, risks and a short summary. Send one JSON object: {city, category, tier, answers, constraints, top_n}.

skills.name: Rank store locations
skills.description: Given a city, category (cafe, clothing, pharmacy), tier (budget, mid, premium), questionnaire answers and constraints, returns the best zones ranked by score with explanations.
